author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a hand home on D, proud long-short march steps, a mirror pattern, song shape, a low left hand beat and two-hand teamwork.

classes.title: Thumb on D, ready to march
classes.goal: Find the hand home on D, between the two black keys, and play the first line slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to place the whole hand

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help your child rest the thumb on D, between them.
classes.childAction: Thumb on D, then one finger on each key up to A.
classes.bridge: D stands between the two black keys, like a hero between two guards.

intro.caption: Ready to march
intro.parentCue: Thumb on D, between the two black keys

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: placing the whole hand with a landmark.

classes.title: Proud step, quick step
classes.goal: Play the march's long-short steps: a proud long note, then a quick one.

mathTarget.parentLine: A long proud note lasts three times the quick one

classes.parentPrompt: March in your seat with your child: a long proud step, then a quick little step.
classes.childAction: Play G long and proud, A quick, then G, E.
classes.bridge: The long note is a big proud stride; the short one is a quick hop.

intro.caption: Proud step, quick step
intro.parentCue: Say 'prooooud, quick' together with the notes

games.caption: Prooooud step, quick step
games.parentCue: Stretch the long note, clip the short one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: long and short notes, three to one.

classes.title: Twice, then an answer
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and find the march tune that comes twice each time.

mathTarget.concept: Form: A A B, then again
mathTarget.parentLine: One tune twice, a different answer, then all of it again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger, then two, for the march tune; wave your hand for each answer.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; count the march tune twice, then wave for the answer.
classes.bridge: March, march, then an answer; march, march, then the ending marches home to C.

intro.caption: Twice, then an answer
intro.parentCue: Count the march tune: one, two, then wave

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the parts of a song.

classes.title: Mirror around E
classes.goal: Practise the E pattern slowly: one step down, back, one step up, back.

mathTarget.parentLine: One step down and one step up, with E in the middle

classes.parentPrompt: Point to E as the middle; say 'down, home, up, home' as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play E, D, E, F, E: down, home, up, home.
classes.bridge: E is the mirror: D on its left and F on its right, one step each.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Point to E: the middle of the mirror

games.caption: Down, home, up, home
games.parentCue: Say the words slowly with each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern that mirrors around one note.

classes.title: The big march drum
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note, C or G, at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Four beats in each bar; the left hand plays on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count one-two-three-four, loud on one, for your child's low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand beats the drum on every one: low C or low G.
classes.bridge: Low C is C in a lower house; it booms like a big march drum.

intro.caption: The big march drum
intro.parentCue: count to four, loud on one

games.caption: Boom on one
games.parentCue: Say one loud with each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats and playing on one.

classes.title: Drum and trumpet
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while four beats go by above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'boom' on each low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand booms and holds; right hand plays the march tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the big drum, low and steady; right hand is the trumpet.

intro.caption: Drum and trumpet
intro.parentCue: Say 'boom' softly on each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two jobs at once.

classes.title: Slow parade, fast parade
classes.goal: Play both hands together a little faster, then slow again if needed.

mathTarget.parentLine: The pattern stays the same when the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: March your feet slowly, then faster, with your child; go back to slow if notes fall apart.
classes.childAction: Play both hands slowly, then a little quicker.
classes.bridge: A slow parade and a quick parade: the same march, a new speed.

intro.caption: Slow parade, fast parade
intro.parentCue: Go back to slow if notes fall apart

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same song at two speeds.

classes.title: March with the band
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: March along with the music. If a note slips, keep marching!
classes.bridge: The band marches on; stay in step and keep going to the end.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part in step with the music.

classes.title: The crowd cheers!
classes.goal: Play the whole march boldly for teddy, then let the crowd cheer.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a strong, proud sound to match a march

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the crowd; after the last C, cheer, clap and wave together.
classes.childAction: Play proudly for teddy, land home on C, then bow.
classes.bridge: Strong, proud fingers, like a hero striding in while the crowd waves.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Seat teddy as the cheering crowd

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a proud sound.
